body: Use the actual water column above the substrate when computing `SubstrateSurface.light_exposure`. The current attenuation term is based on `state.geometry.mean_depth_cm()` (`crates/tank_core/src/types/habitat.rs:117`), but `mean_depth_cm()` is just `fill_height_cm` (`crates/tank_core/src/types/geometry.rs:60-61`), so changing substrate depth does not change substrate-surface light even though the habitat surface moves closer to or farther from the lamp. `TankState::substrate_depth_cm()` already exists (`crates/tank_core/src/types/state.rs:172-177`) and could be used to derive the real water depth above the substrate.
